title: Behind Prayers

outfit_card.silhouette: Grand liturgical ballgown silhouette featuring a heavily structured corset, layered scalloped overskirts, grand cathedral train, and dramatic multi-tiered ruffled trumpet sleeves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Towering golden halo aureole crown, cascading scalloped lace veil, and an intricate forehead chain veil dripping with dangling teardrop pearls and ruby crystals.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-neck bejeweled choker collar, gold-embroidered corset bodice encrusted with rubies, and cascading flared multi-layer lace trumpet sleeves paired with embroidered forest-green devotional gloves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-layered ivory dome skirt with quilted lattice panels, ornate embroidered liturgical heraldic tabards trimmed in pearls, deep ruffled hemline tiers, and concealed bridal petticoats.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Elaborate filigree prayer crests, suspended ruby drops, dangling pearl swags, liturgical iconography, and an ornate golden architectural reliquary lantern.
